clips.title: The story
paras: At Algaz Station in northern Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike watches the road into the Wetlands. A proud member of the Stormpike clan, he guards Ironforge’s supply routes from troggs and kobolds.

At Algaz Station, Mountaineer Stormpike guards the northern road out of Loch Modan. The station stands before the descent through Dun Algaz into the Wetlands, where rocky crags and threats from the wilderness surround it. Stormpike keeps communication open and the road clear for travelers and supply convoys crossing the pass.

Kobolds in nearby digs and troggs from beneath the ground trouble northern Loch Modan. Stormpike asks passing adventurers to disrupt these threats. Kobolds have moved into Silver Stream Mine and taken the Miners' League's stored dwarven tools.
